corpus.description: OWASP Benchmark for Java 1.2: 2,740 servlet test cases across 11 vulnerability categories, each labelled as a real vulnerability or a false-positive trap.
SYNTHETIC line-labelled secrets corpus generated by benchmark/synthetic_secrets.py (seeded). Random values in real credential formats plus realistic decoys; nothing in it was ever a live credential.
Lock files / manifests generated by benchmark/sca_corpus.py pinning known-vulnerable versions in five ecosystems; truth = OSV advisories per package@version, snapshotted in benchmark/sca_truth.json.
